verdict.judgment: Upgraded PASS->WATCH: composite is trough-punished (MFI crisis in 5yr window, crisis-inflated beta). Forward setup (Bain, Asirvad recovery, gold cycle) is a legitimate turnaround watch, not a buy.

thesis: India's #2 gold-loan NBFC (Rs 57,006cr gold AUM, +98% YoY) emerging from its worst 2 years. The Asirvad MFI blowup (RBI embargo Oct-2024) crushed FY25-26 earnings (PAT Rs 2,197cr -> Rs 993cr, ROE 21% -> 7%), but Q1FY27 shows the turn: PAT Rs 585cr (+341% YoY), Asirvad profitable again, gold yields +60bps to 17.7%, Bain Capital's Rs 4,385cr joint-control investment de-risking the balance sheet. At Rs 312 (1.8x book, 10.3x FY28E EPS) it is fairly priced for a recovery -- not cheap enough to buy the uncertainty, too good a franchise to ignore.
asset_quality: Consolidated GNPA 1.5% (FY26, MOFSL) -- remarkably clean for the headline damage, because gold loans (82% of book) barely default. The pain was concentrated in Asirvad MFI (GNPA 4.8% at worst, AUM -49% YoY). Fitch: stage-3 ratio improved to 1.9% by Q1FY27. Gold LTV discipline + daily mark-to-market auction = structural asset-quality moat. Verdict: NOT a balance-sheet risk at consolidated level.
nim: NIM compressed 15.0% (FY24) -> 11.0% (FY26) as MFI provisions ate NII and cost of funds rose (10.4%). Q1FY27: gold yields +60bps to 17.7%, NII +25-33% YoY, Jefferies sees NIM stabilizing off Q4 lows. Direction: recovering, not yet recovered.
risks: MFI regulatory overhang: RBI has shown it will bar disbursals; Asirvad is 18% of AUM -- a repeat would re-crater earnings
Management transition: founder V.P. Nandakumar steps back to Non-Executive Chair Jan-2027; new CEO Ashish Singh unproven in gold loans
Gold-price sensitivity: sharp gold correction would shrink disbursable LTVs and AUM growth
Beta 1.7: the stock is a high-volatility ride; 18% drawdown from 52w high in a flat market
Bain joint control: alignment is positive, but 41.7% promoter block limits float dynamics
catalysts: Q2FY27 results: confirm Asirvad stays profitable and gold yields hold
Bain's operational playbook: branch expansion + co-lending partnerships (RBI opened co-lending for gold loans)
ROE recovery to mid-teens (Jefferies FY27-28) re-rates P/BV from 1.8x toward 2.3x (= Rs 430)
Any dip toward Rs 200-230 (accumulate zone) on market selloff
